title: 2026-11-12 — Affirming a reference needs seeing the link (Greenman)

sections.name: greenman-1
sections.label: Greenman — 2026-11-12
sections.content: I can't really reivew the attached references. There is no way to preview a reference. I can't see where it is linked to. Clicking on the book icon opens a pinned thing far away. i need to see what is linked to what and be able to see the link before I can reliably affirm

sections.name: context
sections.content: Said while reviewing the 113 paragraph-to-reference links about to be published with the essay 'Rebuilding Small Democracy' (muDemocracy.org#489), of which only one had been answered. The missing concept: affirmation acts on a link (this source backs this paragraph), so the writer must see both ends and the link itself. Commented on srs-web#787.
